name: Sakura Synchronicity
original_name: さくらシンクロニシティ
source:
It was April and the first year for Haruka and his younger sister Rise at Sotoorihime Academy, which is surrounded by beautiful cherry blossoms. First meetings with new friends awaited them, as well as reunions with childhood friends. And, as if it was waiting for this exact moment to come, the synchronicity of love begins.

[Edited from [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/02/01/february-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
那是四月，也是遥和妹妹Rise在被美丽樱花包围的外织姫学园的第一年。等待着他们的是与新朋友的第一次见面，以及与儿时好友的重聚。而且，仿佛在等待这一刻的到来，爱的同步性开始了。

[编辑自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/02/01/february-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
